# Ghar-Bhandaa UI & Component Library Survey

**Generated by:** `explorer_survey_ui`  
**Date:** 2026-09-19  
**Status:** Completed  
**Target:** Modernization with `coss` primitives, `coss-particles` patterns, and `transitions-dev` / `transitions-polish` motion token doctrine.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Ecosystem Landscape

Ghar-Bhandaa's component layer is built upon **`@base-ui/react` (v1.7.0)** and **Tailwind CSS v4 (`@tailwindcss/vite` v4.1.18)** with **zero legacy `@radix-ui` dependencies**. This provides a strong, modern foundation for aligning 100% with the [coss UI specification](https://coss.com/ui).

### Key Survey Discoveries:
1. **Core Primitive Alignment:** 23 UI components exist in `src/components/ui/`. Most primitives (`button`, `dialog`, `select`, `tabs`, `table`, `toast`, `card`, `field`, `popover`, `scroll-area`, `avatar`, `checkbox`, `switch`, `separator`) already use `@base-ui/react` hooks (`useRender`, `mergeProps`) and `data-slot` selectors matching coss architectural standards.
2. **Missing Canonical Primitives:** Several high-value coss primitives needed for a world-class management portal are absent:
   - `AlertDialog` (`@base-ui/react/alert-dialog`) for destructive actions (e.g. terminating lease contracts, canceling invoices).
   - `Menu` / `DropdownMenu` (`@base-ui/react/menu`) for table row actions and landlord user profile menus.
   - `Drawer` / `Sheet` (`@base-ui/react` / coss drawer pattern) for mobile header navigation and responsive mobile dialog drawers.
   - `InputGroup` (`@coss/input-group`) for currency prefixes ("NPR"), search icons, and password visibility toggle buttons.
   - `Tooltip` (`@base-ui/react/tooltip`) for icon-only action triggers.
   - `Skeleton` (`@coss/skeleton`) for zero-layout-shift loading placeholders.
   - `NumberField` (`@base-ui/react/number-field`) for monetary paisa/NPR amounts, room floor numbers, and billing day constraints (1–28).
   - `Breadcrumb` (`@coss/breadcrumb`) for deep route trails (e.g. `/invoices/$invoiceId`).
   - `AnchoredToast` (`anchoredToastManager`, `AnchoredToastProvider`) for contextual copy confirmation toasts.
3. **Empty State Pattern Invariant:** Existing empty states (`src/components/ui/empty.tsx`) across all 5 authed route views (`dashboard.tsx`, `properties.tsx`, `rooms.tsx`, `tenants.tsx`, `leases.tsx`) define `EmptyHeader`, `EmptyMedia`, `EmptyTitle`, and `EmptyDescription`, but consistently **omit `EmptyContent` with actionable CTA buttons** (violating coss particle `p-empty-1` guidelines).
4. **Motion System Status:** `src/styles.css` does not yet contain the `transitions-dev` `:root` motion token block or `transitions-polish` scales. Existing CSS animations (`toast-success-odd`, `toast-error-odd`, `.rise-in`) are ad-hoc without unified open/close asymmetry, bounded staggers (<300ms), or complete `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` fallbacks.

## 2. Comprehensive Inventory of Existing Components

### 2.1 UI Component Library (`src/components/ui/`)

#### 1. `Button` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx` — 96 lines)
- **Base Implementation:** `@base-ui/react/merge-props`, `@base-ui/react/use-render`, `cva`.
- **Exports:** `Button`, `buttonVariants`, `ButtonProps`.
- **Variants:** `default`, `destructive`, `destructive-outline`, `ghost`, `link`, `outline`, `secondary`.
- **Sizes:** `default` (h-9/sm:h-8), `sm`, `lg`, `xl`, `xs`, `icon`, `icon-sm`, `icon-lg`, `icon-xl`, `icon-xs`.
- **Features:** Built-in `loading` prop renders `<Spinner data-slot="button-loading-indicator" />`, automatically applies `aria-disabled` and `data-loading`. Explicit default `type="button"` when not using custom `render`. Touch target expanded via `pointer-coarse:after:min-h-11`.
- **coss Mapping:** Fully matches coss `Button` primitive (`references/primitives/button.md`).
- **Relevant Particles:**
  - `p-button-1` (Default button)
  - `p-button-2` (Outline button)
  - `p-button-4` (Destructive button)
  - `p-button-6` (Ghost button)
  - `p-button-13` / `p-button-14` (Icon buttons with `aria-label`)
  - `p-button-41` (Built-in `loading` prop)
  - `p-button-33` (Paired Save/Cancel buttons)
- **A11y & Motion:** Focus ring with `focus-visible:ring-2`. Press animation can be enhanced with tactile `active:scale-[0.98]` and `transitions-dev` micro transitions.

#### 2. `Dialog` (`src/components/ui/dialog.tsx` — 219 lines)
- **Base Implementation:** `@base-ui/react/dialog`, `@base-ui/react/merge-props`, `@base-ui/react/use-render`.
- **Exports:** `Dialog` (Root), `DialogCreateHandle`, `DialogPortal`, `DialogTrigger`, `DialogClose`, `DialogBackdrop`, `DialogViewport`, `DialogPopup`, `DialogHeader`, `DialogFooter`, `DialogTitle`, `DialogDescription`, `DialogPanel`, plus legacy aliases `DialogOverlay`, `DialogContent`.
- **Features:** `DialogPopup` accepts `bottomStickOnMobile` (pins bottom sheet on mobile screens), `showCloseButton`, `portalProps`. Includes scroll fading via `ScrollArea` inside `DialogPanel`.
- **coss Mapping:** Matches coss `Dialog` primitive (`references/primitives/dialog.md`).
- **Relevant Particles:**
  - `p-dialog-1` (Dialog with form: `DialogHeader` outside, `form.contents` wrapping `DialogPanel` + `DialogFooter`)
  - `p-dialog-5` (Long scrollable content with `DialogPanel`)
  - `p-dialog-6` (Bare footer variant)
  - `p-drawer-12` (Responsive dialog on desktop, drawer on mobile)
- **A11y & Motion:** Base UI handles focus trap, focus restoration, and Escape dismissal. Transition currently uses ad-hoc durations (`duration-200`). Needs `transitions-dev` modal open/close asymmetry: `--modal-open-dur: 250ms`, `--modal-close-dur: 150ms`, `--modal-scale: 0.96`, `--modal-ease: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`.

#### 3. `Card` & `CardFrame` (`src/components/ui/card.tsx` — 252 lines)
- **Base Implementation:** `@base-ui/react/merge-props`, `@base-ui/react/use-render`.
- **Exports:** `Card`, `CardFrame`, `CardFrameHeader`, `CardFrameTitle`, `CardFrameDescription`, `CardFrameAction`, `CardFrameFooter`, `CardHeader`, `CardTitle`, `CardDescription`, `CardAction`, `CardPanel` (alias `CardContent`), `CardFooter`.
- **Features:** Inset glint styling, double-border shadows, clip-path integration with embedded tables (`has-data-[slot=table-container]:overflow-hidden`).
- **coss Mapping:** Matches coss `Card` (`references/primitives/card.md`) and `Frame` primitives.
- **Relevant Particles:**
  - `p-card-1` (Basic card with header and footer)
  - `p-card-2` / `p-card-3` (Auth cards with actions and separators)
  - `p-card-7` / `p-card-11` (`CardFrame` with header action)
  - `p-table-7` (`CardFrame` with embedded card-style table)
- **A11y & Motion:** Feature card hover state in `styles.css` needs `transitions-polish` hover-in vs hover-out timing.

#### 4. `Alert` (`src/components/ui/alert.tsx` — 88 lines)
- **Base Implementation:** `cva`, `cn`.
- **Exports:** `Alert`, `AlertTitle`, `AlertDescription`, `AlertAction`.
- **Variants:** `default`, `error`, `info`, `success`, `warning`.
- **Features:** Responsive CSS grid auto-adjusting columns based on icon and action presence (`has-[>svg]:grid-cols-[calc(var(--spacing)*4)_1fr]`).
- **coss Mapping:** Matches coss `Alert` primitive (`references/primitives/alert.md`).
- **Relevant Particles:**
  - `p-alert-2` (Alert with status icon)
  - `p-alert-3` (Alert with icon and action buttons)
  - `p-alert-7` (Error alert for form submission failure)
- **A11y Invariant:** Has `role="alert"`. Semantic status icons must **NOT** have `aria-hidden="true"` because they convey state. Alerts in forms should pair with error-state-shake micro-interactions.

### 2.2 Top-Level Layout & Shell Components (`src/components/`)

#### 1. `LandlordHeader.tsx` (106 lines)
- **Current State:** Sticky blurred header containing the brand badge, 5 navigation links (`Dashboard`, `Properties`, `Rooms`, `Tenants`, `Leases`), user avatar with initials, inline "Sign Out" button, and `ThemeToggle`.
- **Gaps Identified:**
  - **No Mobile Navigation:** On mobile screens (<640px), the 5 nav links and user actions wrap into multiple crowded lines (`flex-wrap`). Missing a mobile hamburger trigger and drawer (`p-drawer-11`).
  - **No User Dropdown Menu:** User details and sign out are rendered inline rather than in a compact profile menu (`Menu` / `p-menu-1`).
  - **Active State Indicator:** Nav links use a CSS pseudo-element underline (`.nav-link::after`). Can be upgraded to coss segmented navigation (`p-navigation-1`) or animated tab indicators.

#### 2. `Header.tsx` (25 lines)
- **Current State:** Public header used on `/login` and `/signup`. Contains only the brand badge and `ThemeToggle`.
- **Enhancement Opportunity:** Include clear navigation links (Back to Home / Features / Sign In / Sign Up) for public visitors.

#### 3. `Footer.tsx` (13 lines)
- **Current State:** Minimal copyright line with year and kicker text.
- **Enhancement Opportunity:** Enrich with helpful secondary links, keyboard shortcuts guide trigger (`Kbd`), and brand metadata.

#### 4. `ThemeToggle.tsx` (82 lines)
- **Current State:** Custom button cycling between `auto` -> `light` -> `dark` -> `auto` with `localStorage` persistence and inline CSS script synchronization in `__root.tsx`.
- **Enhancement Opportunity:** Upgrade to a coss button with smooth icon swap (`Sun` ↔ `Moon` ↔ `Laptop`) using `transitions-dev` `09-icon-swap.md` (cross-fade with blur and scale), or a `Menu` with radio items per `p-menu-4`.

## 4. Missing Components Required for Modernization

To fulfill Requirements R1, R2, and R3, the following components should be introduced into `src/components/ui/`:

### 1. `AlertDialog` (`src/components/ui/alert-dialog.tsx`)
- **Primitive Source:** `@base-ui/react/alert-dialog` (`references/primitives/alert-dialog.md`).
- **Use Cases:**
  - `_authed/leases.tsx`: Terminating active lease contracts.
  - `_authed/invoices.$invoiceId.tsx`: Cancelling invoices or reversing cash payments.
  - `LandlordHeader.tsx`: Confirmation before signing out.
- **Relevant Particles:** `p-alert-dialog-1` (standard alert dialog), `p-alert-dialog-2` (bare footer).

### 2. `Menu` / `DropdownMenu` (`src/components/ui/menu.tsx`)
- **Primitive Source:** `@base-ui/react/menu` (`references/primitives/menu.md`).
- **Use Cases:**
  - `LandlordHeader.tsx`: Landlord profile dropdown (Avatar trigger -> Profile, System Theme, Sign Out).
  - Data Tables (`dashboard.tsx`, `leases.tsx`, `properties.tsx`, `rooms.tsx`, `tenants.tsx`): Row actions menu replacing the single text link with an options menu (`View Details`, `Record Cash Payment`, `Edit`, `End Lease`).
- **Relevant Particles:** `p-menu-1` (full-featured menu), `p-menu-4` (radio groups), `p-menu-5` (link items), `p-menu-6` (grouped sections with labels).

### 3. `Drawer` / `Sheet` (`src/components/ui/drawer.tsx`)
- **Primitive Source:** `@base-ui/react` dialog drawer pattern (`references/primitives/drawer.md`).
- **Use Cases:**
  - `LandlordHeader.tsx`: Responsive mobile navigation drawer for smartphones (<640px).
  - Slide-over panel for quick invoice inspection on the dashboard without full-page navigation.
- **Relevant Particles:** `p-drawer-11` (left mobile menu drawer), `p-drawer-12` (responsive dialog on desktop, drawer on mobile).

### 4. `InputGroup` (`src/components/ui/input-group.tsx`)
- **Primitive Source:** `@coss/input-group` (`references/primitives/input-group.md`).
- **Use Cases:**
  - Rent amount inputs in `leases.tsx` and `dashboard.tsx`: Prefix "NPR" or "रु" addon (`p-input-group-3`).
  - Phone number inputs: "+977" prefix text addon.
  - Password inputs in `login.tsx` and `signup.tsx`: Interactive show/hide eye toggle button (`p-input-9`, `p-input-group-9`).
- **Relevant Particles:** `p-input-group-3` (start text addon), `p-input-group-8` (icon button addon), `p-input-group-20` (search input group).

### 5. `Tooltip` (`src/components/ui/tooltip.tsx`)
- **Primitive Source:** `@base-ui/react/tooltip` (`references/primitives/tooltip.md`).
- **Use Cases:**
  - Icon-only buttons (e.g. line-item delete in `dashboard.tsx`, edit icons in cards).
  - Truncated table cells (e.g. long property names or tenant email addresses).
- **Relevant Particles:** `p-tooltip-1` (basic), `p-tooltip-2` (grouped tooltips with shared intent delay).

### 6. `Skeleton` (`src/components/ui/skeleton.tsx`)
- **Primitive Source:** `@coss/skeleton` (`references/primitives/skeleton.md`).
- **Use Cases:**
  - Dashboard metric card skeletons during initial loader fetch.
  - Table row loading placeholders during router cache invalidation.
- **Relevant Particles:** `p-skeleton-1` (full loading-to-loaded card flow), `p-skeleton-2` (skeleton-only layout).

### 7. `Breadcrumb` (`src/components/ui/breadcrumb.tsx`)
- **Primitive Source:** `@coss/breadcrumb` (`references/primitives/breadcrumb.md`).
- **Use Cases:**
  - `/invoices/$invoiceId`: `Dashboard > Invoices > INV-2026-001`.
- **Relevant Particles:** `p-breadcrumb-1`, `p-breadcrumb-5` (icons before text).

### 8. `NumberField` (`src/components/ui/number-field.tsx`)
- **Primitive Source:** `@base-ui/react/number-field` (`references/primitives/number-field.md`).
- **Use Cases:**
  - Billing Day field (constrained to integers 1 through 28).
  - Rent and security deposit amounts in NPR.
- **Relevant Particles:** `p-number-field-1` (stepper controls), `p-number-field-10` (number field in form).

## 5. Accessibility, Interaction & Contrast Audit

### 5.1 Focus Management & Keyboard Navigation
- **Dialogs & Popovers:** Base UI correctly traps focus within open dialogs and restores focus to the invoking trigger button upon closure. Escape key listeners are active.
- **Buttons:** Every `Button` component enforces `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-1 focus-visible:ring-offset-background`.
- **Tabs:** Arrow keys (Left/Right) cycle active tabs, and Home/End jump to boundaries.
- **Select:** Full arrow-key navigation and typeahead character matching.

### 5.2 ARIA Attributes & Semantic Roles
- **Semantic Status Icons in Alerts:** In `src/components/ui/alert.tsx`, status icons (`AlertCircle`, `CheckCircle2`, `Info`) convey critical information. Per coss rule, they should **never** have `aria-hidden="true"` inside semantic alerts.
- **Icon-Only Buttons:** In `src/routes/_authed/dashboard.tsx` line 512 (the line-item remove button), `aria-label="Remove item"` is properly provided. Any newly introduced icon buttons must maintain explicit `aria-label` attributes.
- **Table Row Checkboxes:** When multi-select tables are introduced, row-level checkboxes require unique `aria-label` tags (e.g. `aria-label={`Select invoice ${inv.period}`}`).

### 5.3 Form Accessibility & Inline Validation
- Currently, forms in `dashboard.tsx`, `leases.tsx`, `properties.tsx`, `rooms.tsx`, and `tenants.tsx` catch errors globally and display a single top-level `<Alert variant="error">`.
- To align with coss forms (`p-field-4`, `p-form-2`):
  - Use `FieldError` on each invalid input so screen readers associate `aria-errormessage` and `aria-invalid="true"` with the exact offending field.
  - Pair with the `transitions-dev` error-state-shake micro-interaction on invalid inputs.

### 5.4 Light & Dark Mode Contrast (OKLCH & Theme Tokens)
- `src/styles.css` defines high-contrast OKLCH color palettes:
  - Light mode: `--background: oklch(1 0 0)`, `--foreground: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)` (contrast ratio > 14:1).
  - Dark mode: `--background: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)`, `--foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0)` (contrast ratio > 15:1).
  - Brand accents: `--lagoon-deep: #328f97` in light mode, `--lagoon-deep: #8de5db` in dark mode, maintaining WCAG AA (4.5:1) compliance for regular text and UI borders.
  - Destructive alerts: `--destructive: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)`, with `--destructive-foreground: var(--color-red-700)` in light and `var(--color-red-400)` in dark.

## 6. Motion & Animation System Integration Plan

Per Requirements R2 and the `transitions-dev` / `transitions-polish` skill doctrines, the motion system must be incorporated into `src/styles.css` and individual components.

### 6.1 Universal Motion Token Doctrine (`src/styles.css`)

The following semantic token block must be added to `:root` in `src/styles.css`:

```css
:root {
  /* transitions-dev & transitions-polish semantic tokens */
  --duration-stagger: 40ms;
  --duration-micro: 80ms;
  --duration-quick: 150ms;
  --duration-fast: 250ms;
  --duration-medium: 350ms;
  --duration-slow: 400ms;
  --duration-very-slow: 500ms;

  --ease-smooth-out: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  --ease-in-out: ease-in-out;
  --ease-out: ease-out;
  --ease-linear: linear;
  --ease-bounce: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.36, 0.64, 1);
  --ease-bounce-strong: cubic-bezier(0.34, 3.85, 0.64, 1);

  --distance-micro: 4px;
  --distance-small: 6px;
  --distance-base: 8px;
  --distance-medium: 12px;
  --distance-large: 30px;

  --scale-large: 0.96;
  --scale-medium: 0.97;
  --scale-small: 0.98;
  --scale-tiny: 0.99;

  --blur-small: 2px;
  --blur-medium: 3px;
  --blur-large: 8px;

  /* Specific component tokens */
  --modal-open-dur: var(--duration-fast);
  --modal-close-dur: var(--duration-quick);
  --modal-scale: var(--scale-large);
  --modal-ease: var(--ease-smooth-out);

  --dropdown-open-dur: var(--duration-fast);
  --dropdown-close-dur: var(--duration-quick);
  --dropdown-pre-scale: var(--scale-medium);
  --dropdown-ease: var(--ease-smooth-out);

  --shake-distance: var(--distance-small);
  --shake-dur-a: var(--duration-micro);
  --shake-dur-b: 60ms;
  --shake-ease: var(--ease-smooth-out);
}
```

### 6.2 Component Motion Mappings

1. **Dialog & Alert Dialog (`06-modal.md`):**
   - **Enter:** `scale(0.96) → scale(1)`, `opacity: 0 → 1`, `duration: 250ms`, `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`.
   - **Exit:** `scale(1) → scale(0.96)`, `opacity: 1 → 0`, `duration: 150ms` (open/close asymmetry).
2. **Select & Menu Dropdowns (`05-menu-dropdown.md`):**
   - Origin-aware scale up from trigger: `scale(0.97) → scale(1)`, `duration: 250ms` on open, `150ms` on close.
3. **Form Error Validation Shake (`12-error-state-shake.md`):**
   - Applied to invalid form fields (`data-invalid` or `FieldError`): 3-cycle horizontal shake with 6px overshoot (`--shake-distance`), auto-reverting after 3000ms.
4. **Theme Toggle Icon Cross-Fade (`09-icon-swap.md`):**
   - Cross-fade between Sun, Moon, and Laptop icons with `scale(0.25) → scale(1)` and 2px blur over 200ms.
5. **Invoice Status Badge Pop-In (`03-notification-badge.md` & `10-success-check.md`):**
   - Payment confirmation checkmark draws path stroke over 550ms with 80ms intent delay.
6. **Tabs Indicator Sliding:**
   - Tabs indicator slides smoothly with `--duration-fast` (250ms) and `--ease-smooth-out`.
7. **Accessibility Motion Guard:**
   - Mandatory `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block neutralizing animations to instantaneous opacity transitions or `none`.

## 7. Actionable Implementation Recommendations

### Phase 1: Style & Token Foundation
- Inject the universal `transitions-dev` and `transitions-polish` CSS variable tokens into `src/styles.css`.
- Add global reduced-motion fallback rules in `src/styles.css`.

### Phase 2: Missing coss Primitives Installation
- Create `src/components/ui/alert-dialog.tsx` built on `@base-ui/react/alert-dialog`.
- Create `src/components/ui/menu.tsx` built on `@base-ui/react/menu`.
- Create `src/components/ui/input-group.tsx` supporting start/end addons, text prefixes, and button triggers.
- Create `src/components/ui/tooltip.tsx` built on `@base-ui/react/tooltip`.
- Create `src/components/ui/skeleton.tsx` for smooth data loading placeholders.
- Add `anchoredToastManager` and `AnchoredToastProvider` exports to `src/components/ui/toast.tsx`.

### Phase 3: Shell & View Overhaul
- **Shell:** Upgrade `LandlordHeader.tsx` with a mobile navigation drawer (`p-drawer-11`) and user profile dropdown menu (`p-menu-1`).
- **Empty States:** Add `<EmptyContent><Button ... /></EmptyContent>` across `dashboard.tsx`, `properties.tsx`, `rooms.tsx`, `tenants.tsx`, and `leases.tsx`.
- **Forms:** Replace global form alerts with inline `FieldError` tags and `InputGroup` addons for currency prefixes and password toggles.
- **Destructive Actions:** Upgrade `endLease` in `leases.tsx` from standard `Dialog` to `AlertDialog`.
- **Data Tables:** Upgrade tabular displays in `dashboard.tsx` and `leases.tsx` to `Table variant="card"`.
